name: Nekomimi Musume no Bukkake Shanikusai
original_name: 猫耳娘のぶっかけ謝肉祭
source: The protagonist, who calls himself a "bukkake leader", one day picks up a stray cat, a cat girl, which begins living as his pet. He starts training her to become his obedient sex slave.
translation: 自封为“颜射队长”的男主角某天捡回了一只流浪猫——一位猫耳娘，并开始将她当作宠物养在家里，一步步把她调教成对自己百依百顺的性奴。
